sloka: जगाम च पुनः गंग भगीरथ रथ अनुगा ।सागरम् च अपि संप्रप्ता सा सरित् प्रवरा तदा ॥१-४३-३८॥
transliteration: jagāma ca punaḥ gaṁga bhagīratha ratha anugā ।sāgaram ca api saṁpraptā sā sarit pravarā tadā ॥1-43-38॥

translations.english: The brilliant (Jahnu) was pleased. He released her through both his both ears. Hence Ganga is called Jahnavi, daughter of Jahnu.
